\[
\begin{aligned}
\Delta\vec{v}
&=\sum_{i=0}^{3}\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x_i^2}\sum_{j=0}^{3}\vec{\delta}_{j}v_j\\
&=\sum_{i=0}^{3}\sum_{j=0}^{3}\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x_i^2}\vec{\delta}_{j}v_j\\
&=\sum_{i=0}^{3}\sum_{j=0}^{3}\vec{\delta}_{j}\frac{\partial^2 v_j}{\partial x_i^2}\\
&=\sum_{j=0}^{3}\vec{\delta}_{j}\left(\frac{\partial^2 v_j}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_j}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_j}{\partial z^2}\right)\\
&=\vec{\delta}_{x}\left(\frac{\partial^2 v_x}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_x}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_x}{\partial z^2}\right)\\
&\quad+\vec{\delta}_{y}\left(\frac{\partial^2 v_y}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_y}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_y}{\partial z^2}\right)\\
&\quad+\vec{\delta}_{z}\left(\frac{\partial^2 v_z}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_z}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v_z}{\partial z^2}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]
